commits.subject: fix(hellobar): serve /hellobar.json at request time, not prerendered
feat(changelog): suggest a site-kick hellobar new command on publish
feat(hellobar): run the hello bar on the site-kick scheduled hellobar.json
commits.body:
Bars live in src/data/hellobar.json (site-kick hellobar CLI, doctor validates).
The v0.7.0 changelog bar runs 2026-10-01 14:00 to 10-08 +07:00 ahead of the
Book Publisher bar, which keeps its old storage key as id. HelloBar.astro keeps
the cc4 look and icon and uses the kit selection logic. /hellobar.json is
prerendered for status --url. helloBar leaves promo.ts.

title: Hello bar now runs on a schedule
bullets: The hello bar at the top of the site now follows a schedule. The changelog bar for v0.7.0 shows from 2026-10-01 14:00 to 10-08 (+07:00), ahead of the Book Publisher bar.
The Book Publisher bar keeps its old identity, so it stays the same bar as before. The bar keeps the same look and icon as before.
Publishing a changelog entry now suggests a command for adding a new hello bar.
